title: Personality 2
note: Above leaf_personality_a2 (kind, honest, rude, serious). The adjectives an adult uses about colleagues and friends. Not feelings-now — that is leaf_feelings_b1. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: the draft's word list was 24/36 REVIEW — twelve tiles were leaf_personality_a2's own words (reliable, generous, clever, calm, ambitious, selfish, lazy, shy, cheerful, serious, creative, curious) and twelve more were taught elsewhere earlier (patient, confident, understanding, mean, nervous, quiet, funny, fair, and four that leaf_self_b1 owns). Only twelve words were new. F7/F8: the recycled ones moved to a **You already know** review board (intro page 1) and the Match list was refilled with 24 character adjectives that are new at this position. · sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 items. · The frames page carried generic noun frames (I have a … / I need a …) on a pack of adjectives; they are adjective frames now, and the false-friend note moved from *sympathetic* (leaf_false_friends_b1 owns it, F2) to *sensible*, which is a tile here. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_personality_b1 — 0 unknown types.

intro.title: You will use these words in
frames: Nobody likes a … boss · *Nikdo nemá rád … šéfa*
intro.note: **sensible** does not mean *senzibilní*. It means **rozumný** — someone who makes good decisions. *Citlivý* is **sensitive**.
